_note: Name-facts for Saint Kitts and Nevis (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: Its Circus, a small roundabout with a clock, was modelled on Piccadilly Circus in London.
Founded by the French in 1627, it is one of the oldest towns of the eastern Caribbean.
it: Il suo Circus, una piccola rotonda con un orologio, fu modellato su Piccadilly Circus a Londra.
Fondata dai francesi nel 1627, è una delle città più antiche dei Caraibi orientali.
